E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)(3, 24, 2)(5, 80, 4)
In a row of 56 students facing North, Yen is 21st from the right end. If Dollar is 19th to the left of Yen, what is Dollar's position from the left end of the line?

Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows. You must assume everything in the information to be true.Recently, the water level in Reservoir X reached a critically low level, affecting water supply to downstream communities. Experts attribute this to prolonged drought conditions in the region.Which of the following can be concluded from the given information? I. Prolonged drought conditions are responsible for the low water level in Reservoir X.II. Building more dams upstream would solve the water supply issues faced by downstream communities.

In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.LINE – NELI – IELNFIND – NDFI – IDFN
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (JUMP – MPJU – UPJM) है।

questions.question: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.Only G is kept above A. Only two boxes are kept between A and F. Only E is kept below C. B is not kept immediately above F.How many boxes are kept between D and E?1458

Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that DOES NOT belong to that group?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

This question is based on the following words.OPT  SEW  DAY  BYEIn each of the words, each vowel is changed to the second letter preceding it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order. In how many letter-clusters thus formed, will no vowel appear?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:All grapes are apples.Some bananas are apples.No banana is a pear.Conclusions:I. No apples are pears.II. Some grapes are bananas.
options: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Neither conclusion I nor II follows.) है।

K, L, M, N, U, V and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. U sits to the immediate right of K. Only three people sit between U and N when counted from the left of U.  Only three people sit between K and V. L sits to the immediate right of X. How many people sit between M and X when counted from the left of X?
If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?88 A 8 C 83 D 16 B 3 = ?

Naksh starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards south. He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 15 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)1863
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (6 km to the east) है।

questions.question:
Each of A, B, C, D, E, F and G gave a lecture on different days of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.
Only two people gave lectures before C. Only two people gave lectures between C and D. E gave the lecture immediately after D. Only two people gave lectures between E and B. A gave the lecture immediately before G.
Who gave the lecture on Friday?1378
